about_the_game:
The story of a boy who goes to meet the twinkling stars and the star that protected the galaxy for countless hours.

Board a spaceship and explore various planets to seal star fragments!

This time, the planets you'll be playing on are Planet Spring Breeze and Planet Steamy.

Make apple pies, rescue friends, (run errands), and sell melon bread!

Chapters 1 and 2 of the Planet Gray Galaxy arc.

This is an exploration-based adventure game.

★☆★☆

Game Features

  • Easy Difficulty

  • Story-focused

  • Press the spacebar to explore your surroundings.

  • Explore specific objects to gain hints.

  • Play Time: Approximately 2 hours

  • Subsequent chapters available.

Controls

  • Up, Down, Left, Right Keys: Movement

  • X Button: Menu

  • Spacebar: Crystal, Investigate, Lift, Pick Up
